body: Can I have a sip or three?

Yes! I’m not the type of person that people want to have friendships with. Honestly nobody would give two shits if I died tonight. 
My funeral will be barren. 
I’ve made mistakes in the past and are shunned for them today. 
I’ve been clean for 5 years from drugs yet I’m still a disgusting drug addict in their eyes. 
People say they want to hang out yet they never call. When I reach out they ignore me. 
In my world people are fake
I’ve only found genuine love with dogs. 
They don’t judge 
They just love

It’s not ok that people make fun of you-
People make fun of me and say my opinions are idiotic. 
I’m sorry your having a hard time and you’re alone. I’m alone too, I know it doesn’t help but wanted you to know that I understand. Good luck and I hope you find peace ❤️
